recentItems.title: 'World War II with Tom Hanks' : Episode 01 Sneak Peek
recentItems.description:
1 September 1939. The day the world changed forever. German troops, tanks and aircraft invaded Poland, sparking the deadliest war in history.

On this day that marks the start of the Second World War, watch Academy Award winner Tom Hanks tell its story in the epic documentary series 'World War II with Tom Hanks', premiering September 1, Tuesday at 9 PM, only on HistoryTV18.
